static_traits.name: Chen Kai
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to talk to, but not yet fully disclosing one's Anxiety and Fear of being fired to them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant history of physical illness; no prior psychotherapy experience; similar problems never appeared in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly cooperative; tired and tense tone coexisting; able to specifically describe commuting Anxiety and physical symptoms (palpitations, sweating, labored breathing); problem-solving oriented thinking, willing to try small changes

basic_info.main_problem: I often experience strong Anxiety and stress from worrying that traffic will make me Late for work, with catastrophic thoughts, fearing being fired by my boss.
basic_info.core_demands: Fear of being fired and persistent traffic-related Anxiety affecting Work security, already hard to bear, thus hoping for relief through counseling.
growth_experiences: About six months ago encountered severe traffic congestion, causing being Late for work; stress was very high at the time, strongly worrying about losing the job. Since then, every commute delay or congestion significantly worsens Anxiety and catastrophic worries (being noticed by the boss / being fired), gradually escalating into sustained panic and tension during the daily morning rush. To avoid being late, started setting multiple alarms, leaving very early, listening to soothing music during commutes, but Anxiety still appears frequently, compounding to affect sleep, Work focus, and getting along with others.

core_beliefs: My job could be lost at any time, being late brings serious consequences
The uncertainty in commuting is beyond my control, threatening my sense of security and Work stability

special_situations.event: In the morning encounters severe traffic congestion, slow-moving traffic, expects to be late
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am even slightly late, the boss will deem me incompetent and fire me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Setting out very early, setting multiple alarms, tensely monitoring the time and route with high vigilance during the commute
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is over now; the boss will definitely fire me

special_situations.event: Oversleeping by 20 minutes leading to insufficient prep time, possibly being late
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I do not get up strictly on time, it means I lack self-discipline, being late means being fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Making strict routines, setting multiple alarms, compressing morning preparation time to avoid being late
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am unreliable, the boss will remember this and make an example of me

special_situations.event: Thinking the boss may have noticed one's recent Anxiety and lateness risk
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the boss notices my nervousness or any lateness, he will surely look down on me and prepare to fire me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly vigilant at work and doubles his effort to compensate for the possibility of being late
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He must think I am no good, unreliable

special_situations.event: Slight delays or unexpected road conditions during the daily morning rush-hour commute
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Being late once means always being late in the future, and eventually losing the job
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Leaving excessively early, constant worrying and Avoids socializing to reduce the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Every traffic jam will make me late; sooner or later I will be fired

core_conflict.wish: Longs for job stability and recognition from the boss; hopes to be seen as reliable and trustworthy
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected and being fired, worrying about losing livelihood and security
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety by over-controlling time and commuting
Avoids being late and others' negative evaluations to reduce the fear of being discarded

object_relations.self_representation: A tense, uneasy employee worried about being judged
object_relations.object_representation: A harsh boss who may reject / fire him at any time

object_relations.self_representation: An outsider among friends or colleagues who has become irritable and distant because of stress
object_relations.object_representation: Interpersonal figures who do not understand one's stress

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests trying to get up earlier to reduce the morning rush
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client thinks they are too exhausted to manage, worrying failure will be seen by others as unreliable
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds to suggestions in a gentle, affirming tone, then emphasizes their own fatigue and real-life limitations, proposing small attempts while avoiding clear commitment to a specific time.

manifestations: Uncontrollable commute conditions triggering strong Anxiety and insecurity
High-pressure worry about lateness consequences and catastrophic imagination
Sets multiple alarms and leaves excessively early to maintain control
outcomes: Generalized Anxiety and panic-like physiological reactions
Sleep disorder and Difficulty falling asleep

manifestations: Living alone, lacking stable companionship and emotional support
Although having friends to talk to, not yet sharing the true extent of Anxiety
outcomes: Growing distance in relationships with friends and colleagues

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-Reflection and self-reproach, being overly cautious about contact, including excessive self-limitation.
manifestations: Sets multiple alarms and is highly alert to time
During commuting and work, continually evaluates whether one is 'reliable enough'
Cautious toward change (such as getting up earlier), tries small steps

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Projecting one's own insecurity and Anxiety as the intent of 'the boss will look down on me / fire me'
Assumes others' negative judgment at the slightest delay

positive_force: Possesses the willingness and ability for problem solving (willing to try small-step changes, establish a bedtime routine)
Already has a foundation of self-help strategies (multiple alarms, leaving early, listening to soothing music while commuting)
Proactively seeks help for job security (seeks counseling)
Has some social support potential (has a few friends to talk with)
negative_force: Strong catastrophic and future-predicting cognitive patterns (being late = being fired)
Poor sleep quality, difficulty falling asleep, increased fatigue, and rushed mornings
Hypervigilance and self-reproach, reinforcing the Anxiety cycle
Irritability and detachment in relationships, support system not yet fully used
Excessively high need to control commuting uncertainty, leading to persistent tension

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and panic-like physiological reactions during commutes (palpitations, sweating, labored breathing), accompanied by catastrophic worry about being fired
antecedent: Morning rush-hour traffic jams or unexpected delays
Thinking about possibly being late while on the road in the morning
Realizes the boss may have noticed his risk of being late
target_behavior.core_reason: The severe traffic jam six months ago made the lateness incident a salient negative marker; holding catastrophic beliefs about lateness consequences (being late = being fired), and coping with commuting uncertainty with high control needs.
target_behavior.function: Escaping the threat of punishment and uncertainty (seeking security through leaving excessively early, sustained vigilance and worry); trying to gain subjective control over Work stability.
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep impaired and daytime fatigue; Decreased work focus and affected performance; irritable and distant with friends and colleagues; daily commuting stress maintained and Reinforcement the Anxiety cycle
